name: user-auth
title: Build RESTful user authentication system
description: Add SQLite-backed UUID users, nickname/password registration and login, 24-hour opaque bearer sessions, self-profile management, logout, migrations, tests, and a Chinese integration handoff.
creator: ariakage
notes: Final product choices approved: nickname/password login, no default account, opaque server-side bearer sessions with a 24-hour lifetime, and current-session logout.
